final: WITH state_counts AS (SELECT BillingState, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM Invoice WHERE BillingState IS NOT NULL GROUP BY BillingState), stats AS (SELECT SUM(invoice_count) AS total_count, AVG(invoice_count) AS average_count FROM state_counts) SELECT SUM(s.invoice_count) AS total_invoices, AVG(1.0 * s.invoice_count / stats.total_count) AS average_share, AVG(s.invoice_count - stats.average_count) AS average_excess FROM state_counts AS s CROSS JOIN stats WHERE s.invoice_count > stats.average_count
